title: Datasource delete refusal: a datasource that objects still use is refused with a plain English sentence and a count, no error code and no object names
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVwQZbHRRM9CaXeKif

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named landing and a measured reproduction. Filed by the `domain:ui#5` seat from the out-of-scope finding (class a) of #30335's card thread (os-dev-report 6657005781, PR #30442). Carrier: the server lane.

**Business reason.** An administrator who deletes a datasource that objects still use gets a refusal no client can explain without guessing: the sentence is English whatever the console's language, and it says how many objects are in the way but not which. PR #30442 works around it in Setup by reading object metadata; any other client (CLI, API caller, another console page) still gets only the count.

**Reader.** The server lane dev in `packages/services/service-datasource/` (the delete guard in `datasource-admin-service.ts`, the route in `admin-routes.ts`).

## Observed (measured on `fdd06415`, `examples/app-showcase`, runtime sqlite datasource with two objects naming it)

- `DELETE /api/v1/datasources/parts_db` answers `HTTP 400` with `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR","message":"Cannot remove datasource 'parts_db': 2 object(s) are still bound to it."}}`.
- The guard throws a plain `Error` (`datasource-admin-service.ts`, the bound-object check in the remove path) and the route's `badRequest` answers every admin error with the same generic `DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR`, so the bound-object refusal cannot be told from any other 400 by code.
- The guard counts bound objects only; the plugin already has `listObjectsBoundTo` (`datasource-admin-plugin.ts`), which the guard does not use.

## Wanted

- The bound-object refusal carries its own error code and the bound objects' names in `details` (the error envelope of ADR-0112), so a client can name them in its own language without re-reading metadata.
- The shape and code name are the server lane's call.

## Not in scope

- The Setup page's own wording: landed by PR #30442 (`domain:ui`), which keeps working from object metadata; once this card lands, the ui may switch to the served list.
- The storage test result's English message (`storage/test`), the other half of #30335.

Refs: #30335.
Dedupe words: datasource delete bound objects, Cannot remove datasource, DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR bound, listObjectsBoundTo refusal. Searched `is:issue datasource delete bound objects` (249 hits, none on this refusal; nearest #30335 itself) and `is:issue "Cannot remove datasource"` (4 hits: #30335 and three closed code-datasource findings, none on this refusal).
